data.name: Fatheen
data.gender_notes: Fatheen is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'fatha' (to open), Fatheen is a name of Allah, meaning 'The Liberator, The Deliverer'. It is often used to refer to a person who frees others from difficulties or hardships. The name Fatheen carries the meaning “Liberator, Deliverer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatheen usually hope their child will grow to embody liberator, deliverer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Fatheen is also associated with the name of Prophet Musa (Moses) who was called 'Khatim Al-Anbiya' (the Seal of the Prophets). He was granted the title 'Al-Fatheh' (the Deliverer) for his role in delivering the Children of Israel from the slavery of Pharaoh.
data.etymology: Fatheen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Liberator, Deliverer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatheen total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
